Messages.Author: Matt Latham
Messages.Body:
Here is relevant card text from Monger

Tap to transfer equipment cards, move blood and transfer retainers between
any two ready vampires you control. (You may choose the amount of blood you
move and which cards you transfer.) Cannot be used during an action.

I know it says vampires, so I seek a clarification. You cannot swap
equipment or blood/life between an ally and a vampire with the Castle, can
you? Between two allies? I am uncertain whether the new text says Vampire or
Minion...

Matt
Denizen of the Sewers of Detroit

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
